title: Geography is four-dimensional
summary: Derek Sivers explores the concept that geography should be understood as four-dimensional, incorporating time as the fourth dimension alongside spatial coordinates. The article likely discusses how places change over time and how our understanding of geography benefits from considering temporal changes.
problem_solved: Challenges the traditional three-dimensional view of geography by introducing time as an essential factor in understanding places.
why_valuable: Offers a fresh perspective on viewing physical spaces, helping readers understand that locations are not static but evolve through time.
